dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: A consistent, symmetrical reduction in lateral pixel width starting from the thoracic midpoint and continuing to the visible posterior extremity.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical, low-frequency deviations from a smooth curve along the lateral pixel boundaries; specifically, small indentations on the left-hand margin relative to the image frame.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Predominantly high-value pixels consistent with a mature white phenotypic phase.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, low-intensity (dark) linear feature along the mid-sagittal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, localized low-intensity clusters along the lateral edges, suggesting surface irregularities or edge nicks.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast pigmentation of the dorsal ridge relative to the white dorsal canvas.
